verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships a first-party MCP server that hands an AI agent read/write access to collections, requests, environments, and teams and lets it send real HTTP requests, effectively enabling natural-language operation of the product through an AI host, and separately offers AI-powered features (renaming requests, generating payloads, writing scripts) inside the app. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that natural-language commands via the MCP server actually work end-to-end, and broader coverage confirming all core product actions (not just data CRUD) are reachable via NL commands.
